items.why: Volatility collapsed as stocks rose, with the Dow jumping 500 points on earnings optimism and falling oil on US-Iran hopes.

summary: Stocks closed higher Tuesday, with the Dow up 500 on earnings optimism and oil falling on US-Iran hopes. Small caps and value led while big tech lagged amid fresh skepticism about the AI trade.
